    selected_call_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]
    # apply replacements from right to left
    for c in reversed(selected):
        s = c['start']
        e = c['end']
        tokens[s:e] = c['replacement_tokens']
    return {'selected_call_ids': selected_call_ids, 'tokens': tokens}
